title: Our Church Family Story

moral.lesson: Our church started small — just a few friends who loved Jesus. Now our church family is celebrating 44 years — and it is still growing! We sing, we learn, we help people, and we love each other. Jesus loves our church family.
moral.application: You are part of our church family. Jesus loves you!

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration like a preschool picture book, simple rounded shapes, oversized friendly heads, thick clean black outlines, soft warm colors, gentle lighting, bright and cheerful, 16:9 landscape composition. Every shirt, dress, and pants is a single solid color. Blank walls and blank signs. No text, letters, numbers, or words. No flags. No rainbows. No rainbow clothing. No speech bubbles.
character: A diverse friendly church community of adults and children. Focus on kids, school, serving, and friendship — no pastors as the focus.

beats.scene: Split illustration, two halves of one wide picture. Left half: a small humble school classroom with gray folding chairs, a plain wooden cross on a brick wall, a small group of smiling families and kids gathered together. Right half: the same friends sitting under a simple blue-and-cream striped outdoor tent on a sunny grassy field. Warm and joyful. People together loving Jesus.
text: A long time ago, our church was very small.
Friends who loved Jesus met at a school… and even under a tent!
That was the start of our church family!

beats.scene: A bright children's ministry classroom. Diverse kids sit on a simple rug singing and clapping. A teacher kneels beside a child in a wheelchair who holds a picture book. A man plays a guitar. A girl shakes a tambourine. A complete, perfectly straight wooden cross hangs level and centered on the yellow wall — not crooked, not broken. Arched windows. Happy CKids class.
text: We sing. We play. We learn that Jesus loves us.
Big kids have fun with their friends at church too!

beats.scene: Sunny Christian school campus. A red-brick schoolhouse with a small bell tower and blank white signboards. Diverse kids with backpacks walk a path; two kids high-five; a child in a wheelchair rolls toward the door; teachers wave from the open doorway. Flowers, trees, bright sun. Friendly Virginia Academy vibe.
text: Our church has a school too — Virginia Academy!
Jesus loves the kids at our school!

beats.scene: Outdoor church food giveaway on a green lawn. Volunteers at tables pack cans, bread, and produce into brown grocery bags. Kids help carry bags. A family receives a box of fruit with big smiles. In the background stands a brick church like Community Church in Ashburn: reddish-brown brick, a white columned front porch with a triangular pediment, tall arched windows, a dark gray roof, and a tall white steeple. Blank walls — no banner, no writing. Generous and friendly.
text: Our church helps people who need food.
We share bags of food with happy smiles.
Helping others is one way we love like Jesus!

beats.scene: Split illustration, two halves of one wide picture. Left half: four children sit in a cozy living-room circle on a rug, holding hands and praying, a cat sleeping nearby, warm lamplight. Right half: church friends outdoors at sunset share food and clothes with neighbors near a small church, round paper lanterns in a tree. Celebration of friendship near and far.
text: Friends meet in little groups to pray and talk.
Our church is 44 years old — and it is still growing!
Jesus loves our church family. You belong here!
